timeout_mechanism: original SIGALRM guards replaced by timing; a call longer than its original deadline gets the original timeout verdict (0); 60 s pebble kill

em.what: published per-item exact_match in the 2024 samples files (not re-computed)

em_rec.extraction: get_unnormalized_answer: regex 'Final Answer: The final answer is(.*?). I hope it is correct.'
em_rec.equivalence: is_equiv: sympy parse_latex both sides, simplify(diff) == 0; no exact-string shortcut

sb.extraction: last_boxed_only_string + remove_boxed on the response (last \boxed{} or \fbox)

equivalence.sb_string: exact string after normalization only (historical Windows behaviour)
equivalence.sb_sympy: exact string OR is_equiv (sympy parse_latex, simplify(diff) == 0)

mv.prediction_parsing: parse(response) with defaults [LatexExtractionConfig(try_extract_without_anchor=True, boxed_match_priority=50, normalization_config=NormalizationConfig(basic_latex=True, units=True, malformed_operators=True, nits=True, boxed='all', equations=False)), ExprExtractionConfig(try_extract_without_anchor=True)], fallback_mode='first_match', extraction_mode='any_match'
mv.gold_parsing: parse(doc['solution'], extraction_config=[LatexExtractionConfig(try_extract_without_anchor=True, boxed_match_priority=50, normalization_config=NormalizationConfig(basic_latex=True, units=True, malformed_operators=True, nits=True, boxed='all', equations=False))])
mv.equivalence: verify(gold, pred) defaults: float_rounding=6, numeric_precision=15, strict=True, allow_set_relation_comp=False
